item.title: Hundreds across Tri-State rally against ICE operations in Minneapolis
item.description: Renee Good and Alex Pretti were shot and killed by ICE agents during an enforcement action, prompting the national day of action that reached from Hamilton County to Anderson.

item.title: No. 24 Miami improves to 22-0, sets MAC record in 85-61 victory over Northern Illinois
item.description: Brant Byers scored 21 points and No. 24 Miami set a Mid-American Conference record with its 22nd straight win, pulling away in the second half for an 85-61 victory over Northern Illinois on Saturday.

item.title: Cincinnati bike rally honors two killed in Minneapolis, protests ICE operations nationwide
item.description: Dozens rode in Cincinnati for a nationwide bike rally honoring two killed in Minneapolis and protesting recent ICE operations, with organizers calling for solidarity with immigrant communities.
